questions.q: Under BP 220, what is the maximum percentage of a family's gross monthly income that should be used to determine the affordability of a housing unit?
questions.n: NEDA and DHSUD utilize 30% of gross family income as the standard for determining the affordable cost of housing.

questions.q: In the hierarchy of basic needs for a BP 220 housing project, which of the following is considered the most immediate priority?
questions.n: In the mandated hierarchy of needs, potable water supply is the primary requirement for any human settlement.

questions.q: For a Socialized Housing project, what is the minimum required lot area for a Row House unit?
questions.n: BP 220 mandates a minimum lot area of 28 sqm for socialized row houses.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of units allowed in a single row house cluster or block?
questions.n: BP 220 limits row house clusters to a maximum of 20 units per block to ensure safety and access.

questions.q: Regarding road hierarchy, what is the minimum Right-of-Way (ROW) width for a Minor Road in a small BP 220 project?
questions.n: The standard minimum ROW for a minor road in BP 220 projects is 6.5 meters.

questions.q: At what building height is an elevator mandatory for Multi-Family Dwellings under BP 220?
questions.n: An elevator becomes a mandatory requirement once a building reaches 6 storeys or more.

questions.q: What is the minimum required distance between two 4-storey BP 220 buildings if the walls have openings?
questions.n: For buildings that are 3 to 4 storeys high, a 6.0m separation is required for light, ventilation, and fire safety.

questions.q: For a Socialized Housing project, what is the minimum required floor area for the housing unit?
questions.n: BP 220 traditionally sets 18 sqm as the absolute minimum for socialized housing units.

questions.q: A ground reservoir for water supply must be located at least how many meters away from a potential source of pollution (like a septic tank)?
questions.n: BP 220 requires a minimum 25-meter distance to prevent cross-contamination of the water supply.

questions.q: Based on the 2026 price ceilings for Socialized Housing (Horizontal), what is the maximum price for a unit with a floor area of 27 sqm and above?
questions.n: Under the most recent updates, the ceiling for socialized house and lot units (27 sqm+) has been increased to ₱950,000.

questions.q: For a subdivision project with a gross area of 2.5 hectares and below, what is the required Right-of-Way (ROW) for a Major Road?
questions.n: For small projects under 2.5 hectares, the minimum major road width is set at 8.0 meters to balance flow and space.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot frontage for a Socialized Single-Detached unit on a regular lot?
questions.n: Both Economic and Socialized single-detached regular lots require a minimum frontage of 8.0 meters.

questions.q: Under the updated 2026 standards, what is the price ceiling for a Socialized Condominium (Vertical) unit in a 5-storey building?
questions.n: The 2026 price ceiling for socialized vertical housing (3-5 storeys) reaches up to ₱1.5 million to cover higher development costs.

questions.q: What is the minimum width of a pathwalk in a socialized housing project if it is intended to provide property access?
questions.n: BP 220 allows 3.0m pathwalks for property access in socialized housing, provided the length does not exceed 60 meters.

questions.q: What is the maximum riser height allowed for stairs in a BP 220 housing unit?
questions.n: BP 220 permits a maximum riser height of 250 mm (0.25m) to save space in small housing units.

questions.q: In a row house cluster, how far must the firewall extend above the roof line?
questions.n: The code requires firewalls to extend 30 centimeters above the roof and beyond the eaves for fire protection.

questions.q: For Economic Housing, what is the minimum lot area for a duplex or attached unit?
questions.n: BP 220 specifies 54 sqm as the minimum lot area for economic duplex/attached housing.

questions.q: What is the minimum clear width for a bathroom (T&B) door in a BP 220 project?
questions.n: The minimum width for T&B doors is 0.60 meters, provided the height is at least 1.80 meters.

questions.q: In a 4-storey multi-family building, what is the minimum required distance between buildings if the walls have NO openings (blank walls)?
questions.n: When walls are blank (no windows or doors), the distance between buildings can be reduced to 2.0 meters regardless of height.

questions.q: Which government agency is responsible for issuing the License to Sell (LTS) for a BP 220 project?
questions.n: The Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) is the primary regulatory body that issues the LTS.

questions.q: What is the minimum required floor area for an Economic Housing unit under BP 220?
questions.n: BP 220 mandates a minimum floor area of 22 sqm for economic housing units.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot frontage for a row house in an Economic Housing project?
questions.n: For economic housing, the minimum row house frontage is 4.0 meters.

questions.q: In the road hierarchy of BP 220, what is the minimum Right-of-Way (ROW) for an Alley?
questions.n: The minimum ROW for an alley, which is used to break long blocks and provide utility access, is 2.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum tread width required for stairs in BP 220 housing?
questions.n: BP 220 specifies a minimum tread of 200 mm (0.20m) for residential stairs.

questions.q: What is the maximum length of a block before a 2.0-meter alley is required to break it?
questions.n: Blocks exceeding 250 meters in length must be provided with an alley at approximately the mid-length.

questions.q: For a multi-family dwelling, how many parking slots are required per unit under BP 220?
questions.n: BP 220 generally requires 1 parking slot for every 8 units to keep the total project cost socialized.

questions.q: What is the minimum required ceiling height for the main floor of a BP 220 housing unit?
questions.n: The minimum ceiling height for a habitable room in BP 220 is 2.0 meters.

questions.q: Which type of drainage system is acceptable for a Socialized Housing project?
questions.n: BP 220 permits lined open canals for socialized housing to reduce development costs.

questions.q: What is the minimum required distance between the front building line and the road right-of-way (front setback)?
questions.n: The standard front setback for BP 220 housing is 1.5 meters.

questions.q: For a Socialized Housing subdivision of 10 hectares, what is the required ROW for a Major Road?
questions.n: For projects between 5.0 and 10.0 hectares, the major road ROW must be at least 10.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the maximum length of a Motor Court (dead-end) under BP 220?
questions.n: BP 220 limits motor courts to 60 meters to ensure vehicles can still maneuver effectively.

questions.q: What is the minimum required rear setback for a BP 220 house and lot unit?
questions.n: The rear setback must be at least 2.0 meters to allow for utilities and ventilation.

questions.q: For a multi-family dwelling, what is the minimum floor area for a Socialized unit?
questions.n: The minimum floor area for both horizontal and vertical socialized housing is 18 sqm.

questions.q: What is the minimum width of a corridor in a BP 220 multi-family building?
questions.n: BP 220 allows for a minimum corridor width of 1.00 meter for residential accessibility.

questions.q: If a developer builds a 6-storey socialized housing building, what is the mandatory elevator requirement?
o: No elevator required if it is socialized
questions.n: An elevator is mandatory for any BP 220 building that is 6 storeys or higher.

questions.q: Under the 2026 guidelines, what is the price ceiling for a Socialized House and Lot with a floor area of 22 sqm?
questions.n: The 2026 update establishes ₱950,000 as the ceiling for socialized horizontal units (27sqm and above), but 22sqm units often fall in the lower ₱850k bracket.

questions.q: What is the minimum required water supply in liters per capita per day (LCPD) for a BP 220 project?
questions.n: BP 220 specifies a minimum of 150 liters per person per day to ensure adequate sanitation.

questions.q: What is the minimum required distance between two buildings that are 2 storeys high (with openings)?
questions.n: BP 220 requires a 4.0-meter separation between 1-2 storey buildings with windows.

questions.q: A pathwalk in a socialized housing development must NOT exceed what length if it is used for property access?
questions.n: Pathwalks for property access are limited to a maximum length of 60 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot frontage for a Duplex or Attached unit in an Economic Housing project?
questions.n: Duplex/Attached units in Economic housing projects must have a minimum frontage of 6.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum required side setback for a BP 220 house unit?
questions.n: The standard side setback for housing units under BP 220 is 1.5 meters.

questions.q: For a row house unit in Economic housing, what is the minimum required lot area?
questions.n: BP 220 requires a minimum lot area of 36 sqm for economic row houses.

questions.q: What is the minimum required area for a single Park or Playground within a subdivision?
questions.n: BP 220 mandates that no park or playground shall be smaller than 100 sqm.

questions.q: For a large project over 30 hectares, what is the required ROW for the Major Road?
questions.n: Projects exceeding 30 hectares must have a major road ROW of 15.0 meters.

questions.q: Which utility is ranked 3rd in the hierarchy of basic needs for housing?
questions.n: Storm drainage is the 3rd priority in the mandated hierarchy.

questions.q: What is the minimum height clearance allowed for a mezzanine floor in BP 220?
questions.n: BP 220 allows a minimum ceiling height of 1.8 meters for mezzanine floors.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of row house units allowed per block if a 2.0m alley is NOT provided at midlength?
questions.n: The maximum number of row house units in a single cluster is 20 units.

questions.q: For an Economic Housing unit, what is the minimum required width for the main entrance door?
questions.n: The main door for any housing unit under BP 220 must be at least 0.80 meters wide.

questions.q: What is the minimum required lot frontage for a single-detached regular lot in a Socialized project?
questions.n: Regardless of whether it is socialized or economic, a single-detached regular lot must have 8.0m frontage.

questions.q: Which document is required before a developer can actually start selling units to the public?
questions.n: No developer can legally sell or contract to sell units without a valid License to Sell from DHSUD.

questions.q: Under the 2026 update, what is the ceiling price for an Economic Housing unit with 48 sqm floor area?
questions.n: Economic housing projects now have price ceilings reaching up to ₱2.5 million to reflect modern costs.

questions.q: What is the maximum distance a block can go without being broken by a street, alley, or pathwalk?
questions.n: The absolute maximum length of a block in BP 220 is 400 meters.

questions.q: For a multi-family dwelling, what is the required distance between buildings if they are 5 storeys or taller (with openings)?
questions.n: Buildings taller than 4 storeys must be separated by at least 10.0 meters for safety and ventilation.

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage for a single-detached unit on an interior lot?
questions.n: Interior lots only require a 3.0-meter frontage, as they are accessed via an easement or private lane.

questions.q: What is the minimum required width for a stairwell in a BP 220 housing unit?
questions.n: The minimum stair width for residential units under BP 220 is 0.60 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum clear height for a main door in BP 220?
questions.n: Main doors and bedroom doors must have a minimum height of 2.00 meters.

questions.q: In a 10-hectare subdivision, what is the required ROW for a Minor Road?
questions.n: In developments of 5 to 10 hectares, the minor road ROW is increased to 8.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the required thickness for a firewall under BP 220?
questions.n: Firewalls must be at least 150 mm (6 inches) thick to provide the necessary fire resistance between units.

questions.q: For a Socialized Housing project, what is the minimum lot area for a Single Detached unit?
questions.n: BP 220 mandates a minimum lot area of 64 sqm for socialized single-detached units.

questions.q: What is the maximum price for a Vertical Socialized Housing unit in a building 6 storeys or higher as per 2026 updates?
questions.n: The ceiling for vertical socialized housing in high-rise settings (6 storeys+) is ₱1.8 million to account for elevators and structural costs.

questions.q: What does the 'BP' in BP 220 stand for?
questions.n: BP stands for Batas Pambansa, which means 'National Law' in Filipino.

questions.q: Which of these is the primary goal of BP 220?
o: Establish standards for socialized and economic housing
questions.n: BP 220 was created to provide flexible standards for affordable housing to address the housing backlog.

questions.q: What is the minimum required ceiling height for a habitable room in BP 220?
questions.n: The code allows a minimum of 2.00 meters to maximize space in low-cost housing.

questions.q: Which basic need is prioritized second in the hierarchy for BP 220 housing?
questions.n: After water, the ability for people and vehicles to move is the 2nd priority.

questions.q: True or False: A row house block can have a maximum length of 100 meters.
questions.n: BP 220 limits row house clusters to a maximum length of 100 meters per block.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot area for an Economic Row House?
questions.n: Economic row houses require slightly more land, with a minimum of 36 sqm.

questions.q: What is the minimum floor area for a Socialized Housing unit?
questions.n: BP 220 traditionally allows for units as small as 18 sqm to ensure maximum affordability.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT a permitted material for a socialized housing drainage system?
questions.n: Drainage must be lined or piped to prevent erosion and stagnant water.

questions.q: What is the required minimum frontage for a socialized row house?
questions.n: Socialized row houses are allowed a narrow frontage of 3.5 meters to maximize the number of units.

questions.q: For a socialized housing project, how much water should be provided per capita per day?
questions.n: The standard requirement for water supply is 150 liters per person per day.

questions.q: What is the minimum width for a pathwalk used for property access in socialized housing?
questions.n: Pathwalks serving as property access must be at least 3.0 meters wide.

questions.q: In a 3-storey BP 220 building with openings, what is the minimum distance between buildings?
questions.n: Buildings with 3 to 4 storeys require a 6.0-meter separation for light and air.

questions.q: What is the maximum riser height for stairs in a housing unit?
questions.n: To save space, BP 220 allows a steep riser of up to 250 mm.

questions.q: What is the minimum tread width for stairs in BP 220?
questions.n: The minimum tread allowed is 200 mm to ensure a foot can safely land.

questions.q: Which agency issues the Development Permit for a subdivision?
questions.n: The LGU is responsible for checking compliance with local zoning and issuing the Development Permit.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of row house units allowed in a single cluster?
questions.n: BP 220 allows up to 20 units in a row before a physical break is required.

questions.q: What is the minimum width for a main entrance door in BP 220?
questions.n: The main entrance must be at least 0.80 meters wide for basic access.

questions.q: The firewall should extend at least how many centimeters above the roof line?
questions.n: A 30 cm (0.30m) extension is required for fire safety.

questions.q: What is the minimum required thickness of a concrete firewall?
questions.n: A minimum of 150 mm (6 inches) is required for a solid firewall.

questions.q: How far must a ground reservoir for water be from a septic tank?
questions.n: A minimum of 25 meters is required to ensure the water supply is not contaminated by sewage.

questions.q: For a project with openings, what is the distance between 5-storey buildings?
questions.n: Once a building exceeds 4 storeys, the separation distance jumps to 10.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot frontage for an Economic Single Detached lot?
questions.n: Single detached lots in economic housing must have an 8.0-meter frontage.

questions.q: True or False: Economic housing has higher price ceilings than socialized housing.
questions.n: Economic housing is aimed at a slightly higher income bracket and allows for higher development costs.

questions.q: What is the minimum width for an alley in BP 220?
questions.n: The minimum Right-of-Way for an alley is 2.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot area for an Economic Single Detached lot?
questions.n: Economic single detached units require a minimum of 72 sqm lot area.

questions.q: Which of these is the most important utility in BP 220?
questions.n: Clean water is the top priority for health and sanitation in any development.

questions.q: What is the minimum floor area for Economic Housing?
questions.n: Economic housing units must have at least 22 sqm of floor area.

questions.q: In a socialized housing project, when are parks and playgrounds mandatory?
questions.n: The requirement for P&P begins once the project reaches 1 hectare (10,000 sqm).

questions.q: What is the minimum width for a stairs in BP 220?
questions.n: The code allows a very narrow stair width of 0.60 meters to fit into compact units.

questions.q: True or False: A pathwalk can be used as primary property access for an Economic house.
questions.n: Pathwalk access is only permitted for Socialized housing units.

questions.q: What is the minimum Right-of-Way for a Major Road in a small (2.5 ha) project?
questions.n: The major road must be at least 8.0 meters wide even in small developments.

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage for an interior lot?
questions.n: Interior lots only require a 3.0-meter access lane/frontage.

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage for a duplex unit?
questions.n: Both socialized and economic duplexes require a 6.0-meter frontage per unit.

questions.q: How deep is the required rear setback for a BP 220 house?
questions.n: The rear setback must be 2.0 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum distance between buildings with blank walls?
questions.n: If there are no windows or doors, the buildings can be as close as 2.0 meters.

questions.q: Elevators are mandatory starting at what floor level?
questions.n: Buildings with 6 storeys or more must have an elevator.

questions.q: What is the minimum door width for a bathroom (T&B)?
questions.n: Bathroom doors have a minimum width of 0.60 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum floor area for a condominium unit in BP 220?
questions.n: Both subdivision houses and condominium units start at 18 sqm.

questions.q: In a 4-storey building, what is the distance between buildings (with openings)?
questions.n: Buildings that are 3 to 4 storeys high require a 6.0-meter separation.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of storeys for a BP 220 walk-up building?
questions.n: A 5-storey building is the maximum allowed without a mandatory elevator.

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage for a row house in Economic housing?
questions.n: Economic row houses require a 4.0-meter frontage.

questions.q: What is the minimum corridor width in a multi-family building?
questions.n: The minimum width for a corridor in a multi-family dwelling is 1.00 meter.

questions.q: True or False: A motor court can be as long as 100 meters.
questions.n: The maximum length for a motor court is 60 meters.

questions.q: What is the minimum lot area for a Socialized Duplex?
questions.n: Socialized duplexes require a 48 sqm lot.

questions.q: What is the minimum height for a T&B door?
questions.n: T&B doors can be slightly shorter at 1.80 meters to save on materials.

questions.q: True or False: Power supply is the most important need in the hierarchy.
questions.n: Power is actually the 6th and last priority in the hierarchy of basic needs.

questions.q: What is the minimum frontage for a corner lot (single detached)?
questions.n: The minimum frontage for a regular or corner single-detached lot is 8.0 meters.

questions.q: How wide is a pathwalk meant for pedestrians only?
questions.n: A pathwalk for property access is 3.0 meters, but the code allows for different types.

questions.q: What is the maximum length of a cluster of row houses?
questions.n: Clusters are limited to 100 meters in length to prevent excessively long continuous structures.

questions.q: What is the minimum side setback for a BP 220 house?
questions.n: The side setback must be at least 1.5 meters.
